subject: How to change the order of groups in a factor variable without changing other corresponding variable

messages.author: 3cb8e5cfad3e6a9f
messages.subject: How to change the order of groups in a factor variable without changing other corresponding variable
parts:
Hi,
    I tried the following script to change the order of groups in a factor, but I found as a result, the groups with the changed order can't match with other variables which used to correspond these groups. So what's the solution? (imagine I have three groups for a variable). Thanks!

variableName<-factor(variableName, levles = levels(variableName)[c(2,1, 3)])

Best,
Grace
